name: Japan Prime Realty Investment Corporation
summary: Japan Prime Realty Investment Corporation (JPR) under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended), and was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Section of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (the Tokyo Stock Exchange) on June 14, 2002, with 289,600 outstanding investment units. With the subsequently implemented public offerings and other capital raising measures by JPR, the number of investment units issued and outstanding totals 4,048,256 units as of the end of the 48th fiscal period (December 31, 2025).
